yoyaku.text:
Rainy streets, late-night lights, and a Japanese melody made for after dark.

Ms.OOJA — 恋人も濡れる街角 (Koibito mo Nureru Machikado)

Hear how her smoky voice turns an old classic into a small film of longing.

https://joy-relief-station.lovable.app/cover-guide?artist=ms-ooja&song=koibito-mo-nureru

#MsOOJA #恋人も濡れる街角

More than 50 years later, the question still hasn’t gone away.

Marvin Gaye — “What’s Going On”

A tender protest sung with compassion. It asks us to listen to one another before we answer—and makes that request feel urgent again today.

https://joy-relief-station.lovable.app/cover-guide?artist=marvin-gaye&song=whats-going-on

#MarvinGaye

For anyone who has ever felt a little out of place, here is a Japanese night song.

KIRINJI — エイリアンズ (Aliens)

Two people drift through a sleeping city, as if their own small world is the only place they truly belong.

https://joy-relief-station.lovable.app/cover-guide?artist=kirinji&song=aliens

#KIRINJI #キリンジ

Thousands have sung “Hallelujah.” Few have made the arena feel this quiet.

k.d. lang — “Hallelujah” at Vancouver 2010

Listen for the moment the crowd seems to hold its breath. No spectacle; her voice carries the room.

https://joy-relief-station.lovable.app/cover-guide?artist=kd-lang&song=hallelujah-vancouver-2010

#kdlang #Hallelujah

yoyaku.midashi: RC Succession — スローバラード (Slow Ballad)
yoyaku.text:
Not every Japanese classic is polished or delicate.

RC Succession — スローバラード (Slow Ballad)

Two people in a car at night.
A rough voice, a quiet scene, and one of Japan’s great love songs.

https://joy-relief-station.lovable.app/cover-guide?artist=rc-succession&song=slow-ballad

#RCSuccession #忌野清志郎

Some songs try to cheer you up.
This one simply says: call me, and I’ll be there.

Carole King — “You’ve Got a Friend”

One of the warmest promises ever put into a song.

https://joy-relief-station.lovable.app/cover-guide?artist=carole-king&song=you-got-a-friend

#CaroleKing

The first light of autumn, and a daughter about to leave home.

Momoe Yamaguchi — 秋桜 (Cosmos)

She sings to her mother with the tenderness of someone who knows tomorrow will change everything.

https://joy-relief-station.lovable.app/cover-guide?artist=momoe&song=cosmos

#MomoeYamaguchi #秋桜

Autumn arrives softly in Nat King Cole’s voice.

“Autumn Leaves” — Nat King Cole

A song about what remains after someone has gone, sung with the warmth of someone still holding the memory close.

https://joy-relief-station.lovable.app/cover-guide?artist=nat-king-cole&song=autumn-leaves-remastered-1987

#NatKingCole #AutumnLeaves

A summer memory can stay long after the season ends.

Tatsuro Yamashita — さよなら夏の日

Released in 1991, the song received its first music video thirty years later. Rain becomes a memory.

September ended two days ago. The groove didn’t.

The opening notes still make a room move before anyone has time to think about the calendar.
